branches.name: Economy
branches.blurb: A richer town on day one.

branches.name: Quests
branches.blurb: More from every notice on the board.

branches.name: Town
branches.blurb: Skip the early building and the early waiting.

upgrades.name: Seed Purse
upgrades.blurb: Each new run starts with gold in the strongbox.

upgrades.name: Merchant Ledgers
upgrades.blurb: More gold from every Market and from the Warden's stipend.

upgrades.name: Many Hands
upgrades.blurb: More lumber, stone and food from the camps, quarries and farms.

upgrades.name: Deep Cellars
upgrades.blurb: Warehouses hold more lumber, stone and food.

upgrades.name: Old Foundations
upgrades.blurb: Market, Lumber Camp, Farm, House, Quarry and Warehouse begin each run already built to this level.

upgrades.name: Hard-won Lessons
upgrades.blurb: Heroes earn more experience from drilling and quests.

upgrades.name: A Name That Travels
upgrades.blurb: Adventurers ask for less to join, sworn recruits included.

upgrades.name: Hot Broth and Clean Linen
upgrades.blurb: Injured heroes recover faster.

upgrades.name: Extra Bunks
upgrades.blurb: Room for more heroes on the roster.

upgrades.name: Forge-lore
upgrades.blurb: Gear costs less to forge.

upgrades.name: Generous Patrons
upgrades.blurb: Quests pay more gold.

upgrades.name: Marked Roads
upgrades.blurb: Parties travel and fight faster, so quests finish sooner.

upgrades.name: Busy Noticeboard
upgrades.blurb: New notices reach the board sooner.

upgrades.name: Friends in Every Inn
upgrades.blurb: Zone reputation grows faster.

upgrades.name: Scouts' Maps
upgrades.blurb: Each run starts with the gate dungeons already cleared: Fargodeep Mine first, then the Deadmines.

upgrades.name: Head Start
upgrades.blurb: Each run begins with the Town Hall already raised to this level.

upgrades.name: Guild Masons
upgrades.blurb: Buildings cost less gold and materials.

upgrades.name: Royal Charter
upgrades.blurb: Town Hall upgrades cost less.

upgrades.name: Spare Cottages
upgrades.blurb: Housing for extra residents before any House is built.

upgrades.name: Thrifty Larders
upgrades.blurb: Residents eat less.
